name: Jochebed
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Chapter 6 is dealing with the genealogy: the families of Reuben, Simeon, and Levi, and out of Levi came Moses and Aaron. Levi begat Kohath, Kohath begat Amram, and Amram took Jochebed to wife, and she bare him Aaron and Moses.

note.label: Exodus 6: The Promise Renewed and the Generations of Moses and Aaron

points: Jochebed the daughter of Levi bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister; and unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel
